messages:
maria: quick design check 4: legend placement — inline above the chart vs pinned right. prototyped both, sharing thoughts?
jon: inline saves vertical space but can clash with chart title. pinned-right is clearer on desktop but uses horiz space.
aisha: on mobile inline works better; desktop pinned-right reads more naturally.
liam: do we know legend interaction usage? hover toggles are low. maybe default collapsed unless user changes it.
maria: analytics shows legend toggles <5% overall.
jon: proposal: expanded by default on wide screens, collapsed on narrow, with a persistent user pref (cookie/user setting).
aisha: accessibility: legend toggles must be real checkboxes with aria-checked and descriptive aria-labels e.g. aria-label=\"Toggle: Org spend (February 2025)\"
liam: also add keyboard focus visible styles and ensure toggles are reachable in tab order.
maria: copy suggestion: button to expand legend currently says \"Show legend\". think we can do better.
jon: maybe \"Legend & visibility\" or \"Chart legend\". short and clear.
aisha: prefer \"Legend & visibility\" because it implies settings.
maria: invoice CTA: currently \"Export\" which confused users. change to \"Download invoice (PDF)\" and add aria-describedby pointing to invoice-month.
liam: mobile layout issue: org/project chip group wraps awkwardly. suggestion: collapse into an overflow menu on small screens and show a breadcrumb for scope.
jon: add tooltip on the scope toggle: \"Switch to project-level spend to see per-project breakdown\" — appears on hover and focus.
aisha: color contrast: two legend swatches fall below 4.5:1; update palette or add patterns for distinction.
maria: plan: right-pinned legend on desktop (respects user pref), collapsed inline on mobile with overflow menu, legend label \"Legend & visibility\", invoice button copy updated, contrast adjusted. will update figma.
sam-bot: Prototype updated: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234  @maria pinned the latest frame.
jon: ok to move to dev backlog once designs updated?
aisha: yes, will run quick a11y smoke after dev flags are up.
liam: no objections.
maria: thanks everyone, i'll push changes to the backlog and add tickets for: legend pref, a11y fixes, invoice CTA copy, mobile overflow.
